errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: Your account no longer has admin access. Sign in again with an admin account.
errors.rateLimited: You are going too fast, so the server paused you. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.notFound: This record could not be found. It may have just been deleted.
errors.conversationNotFound: This conversation does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
errors.postConflict: The server copy has changed (you may have this post open in another tab). Reload to get the latest version — unsaved changes here will be lost.
errors.slugTaken: Another post already uses this slug. Pick a different one and save again.

socket.offline: Connection lost — your message will be sent once you are back online.
socket.rateLimited: You are sending too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
socket.notFound: This conversation is no longer available.
socket.validationFailed: That message content is not valid.

errors.forbiddenAction: You do not have permission to do that
errors.tooFast: You are going too fast, please try again shortly
errors.serverError: The server is having trouble, please try again
errors.storageForbidden: Storage refused the upload (403). Usually the upload link expired — start over; if it keeps happening it is the server's host or clock configuration.
errors.slugAliasNotFound: This old URL no longer exists — someone may have just deleted it.

guard.sessionErrorMessage: Try reloading the page. If it keeps failing, the backend is not responding.
guard.deniedMessage: This area is only for {role} accounts. You are signed in as {email}.
guard.signInAsOther: Sign in with a different account
